# Security Checklist: Walking Skeleton

**Purpose**: Review the quality of the security requirements (transport, exposure, secrets, hardening) before tasks are written
**Created**: 2026-11-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is every connection that must be encrypted listed, including identity provider → database and health checks? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Plan R5]
- [ ] CHK002 Are certificate lifetime and what happens at expiry specified, beyond the edge case that names the certificate? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 Is it specified how a developer trusts the project certificate authority in the browser, or is that left to the quickstart only? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for logs: that no secret, key or credential is ever written to them? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the set of credentials each component receives listed, so "least privileges" can be checked? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, Data Model §Roles]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Are the security headers named, rather than described as "restricting framing, content sources and transport"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the per-client request rate limit given as a number? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "verify the other side's certificate" defined to include host-name verification, not only chain verification? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "without write access to its own program files" defined for components that must write data (database, cache volumes)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Do "created locally on first use and not tracked by the repository" (FR-017) and the plan's handling of development passwords agree? [Conflict, Spec §FR-017, Plan R4]
- [ ] CHK011 Does the user story 3 wording on exposure match FR-015 and SC-005 after clarification Q1? [Consistency, Spec §US3, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the open, unauthenticated read of the roadmap consistently limited to sample data and the local machine across spec, plan and constitution check? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Constitution Check]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK013 Is behaviour defined when the certificate authority or a certificate file is missing or unreadable at start? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 Is behaviour defined when a generated secret file exists but is empty or malformed? [Coverage, Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements defined for regenerating certificates and secrets (for example after a suspected leak) without losing data? [Coverage, Recovery, Gap]

## Measurability

- [ ] CHK016 Can SC-004 ("100% of connections encrypted and verified") be verified from a list of connections in the spec, rather than by inspection? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK017 Is SC-006 ("zero secrets in the repository and its history") tied to a named scan scope, including the submodule? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Notes

- Defaults used, since PLAN §5 asks the owner for input only at clarify: audience PR reviewers, standard depth, focus on the two highest-risk areas (this file and [gates.md](gates.md)).
- Items CHK002, CHK006, CHK007, CHK010 and CHK013 found real gaps; the spec and research were amended on 2026-11-13 (see the spec's "Amendments after checklist" note). Ticking them remains the reviewer's call.
